cat > /home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u009/system/state/workspace/programs/task-86e6a405.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Keep the green cross and color cells whose Chebyshev distance to it is even."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cross_row = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
    cross_col = next(j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 3 for i in range(h)))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if i == cross_row or j == cross_col:
                out[i][j] = 3
            elif max(abs(i - cross_row), abs(j - cross_col)) % 2 == 0:
                out[i][j] = 4
    return out
PY
